description: Guides automated testing of SPIP plugins and squelettes using PHPUnit — the standard test tool for SPIP. Covers the full self-contained setup (composer, spip-cli), unit tests with lightweight mocks, and integration tests against a real SPIP instance. Written for SPIP 4.x; on a SPIP 5.0 project the integration bootstrap and test install change (see the SPIP 5.0 section). Use whenever the user wants to test, verify, or validate a SPIP plugin or squelette — even if they don't mention PHPUnit — including questions like "how do I test my plugin", "I want to make sure my filtre works", or "how do I write tests for my autorisation / CVT form /
